To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the time modulation of the medium permittivity, induced by a scattering field pulse, results in a phase self-modulation that increases the delay time of the cooperative scattering pulse and reduces slightly the scattering pulse duration.
the temporal characteristics of the cooperative Raman scattering of a high-power pulse of radiation in a nonlinear medium depend on the time modulation of the dielectric permittivity of the medium.
the temporal characteristics of the cooperative scattering are influenced by the phase self-modulation induced in the medium by a strong scattering field pulse.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the influence of the self-modulation of the permittivities on the temporal characteristics and the spatial structure of the scattering field in the process of cooperative scattering of light in a medium.
the effect of phase self-modulations of light on cooperative scattering.
the effect of phase self-mododulation on the temporal characteristics (delay time and duration) of the intensity of cooperative scattering.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effect of the phase modulation of light on the cooperative scattering is small and can be neglected in most cases of practical interest.
the phase self-modulation has a significant influence on the temporal characteristics (delay time and pulse duration) of the cooperative scattering.

the effect of phase modulation of the permittance of the medium on the cooperative Raman scattering intensity is insignificant and that this effect is not a limiting factor in the use of this method of pulse compression.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the cooperative scattering of light in an optically dense medium is accompanied by a time modulation of the medium's dielectric permittivity, and this effect leads to the self-modulation of the scattering intensity.

the cooperative scattering of light by the Raman process is a promising method of studying the dynamics of molecular systems and the effect of phase self-modulating on the cooperative scattering can provide an additional tool to control the temporal characteristics of the scattered light.
the phase self-modulation does not change the shape and the duration of the cooperative pulse, but only increases the delay time.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cooperative Raman scattering is a very sensitive indicator of the phase self-modulation effect in a scattering medium.
the cooperative Raman scattering is not a good tool for the investigation of the dynamics of phase self-modification of light.
the cooperative Raman scattering is a promising technique for measuring the temporal characteristics of the phase self-modulation.
